verdict.rationale: MoonPay's off-ramp is a user-initiated widget flow for selling crypto to a bank account or card, and its enterprise offering converts incoming fiat into stablecoins, which is the opposite direction. Neither is a documented merchant option to accept crypto payments and auto-convert stablecoin receipts into a fiat balance or bank payout. Manually running receipts through the consumer off-ramp would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.
